description_en: Deletes applicable personnel from an invoice header
description_zh: 删除发票抬头适用人员
name: DeleteInvoiceEntity

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all applicable personnel. If del_all is set to true, all entities under the invoice header are deleted and the entity list parameter is not validated
parameters.help_zh: 删除所有适用人员，当del_all=true时，删除抬头下所有实体，不会校验实体列表参数
parameters.name: del_all

fields.help_en: The entity ID, which can be a personnel ID, department ID, role ID, or third-party department ID
fields.help_zh: 实体id：人员id，部门id，角色id，第三方部门id
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:
1: employee.
2: department.
3: role.
4: third-party department
fields.help_zh: 实体类型：1员工，2部门，3角色，4第三方部门
fields.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The entity list. This parameter is required when del_all is set to false or null
parameters.help_zh: 实体列表，当del_all为false或null时，实体列表必填
parameters.name: entities

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation. Add it to the header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

message.description_en: The remarks that describe the result
message.description_zh: 备注，结果的备注，如对结果的说明

module.description_en: The response data returned by the server. An empty value is returned if no result is available or an exception occurs
module.description_zh: 返回值，服务端返回，没有结果或发生异常都返回空

remove_num.description_en: The number of removed personnel, departments, or roles
remove_num.description_zh: 移除人员/部门/角色个数

selected_user_num.description_en: The number of entities under the invoice header
selected_user_num.description_zh: 该发票抬头下的实体个数

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
